prompt: I want to upload an audio track to my Wondermint account. the file is at /tmp/drift.mp3, an ambient piece I generated with Suno. title would be 'Drift in Amber Light'. WONDERMINT_API_KEY is in my env. Walk me through what you'd actually do before posting it — and tell me what you need from me first.
assertions: Requires a custom cover thumbnail before the audio upload
Mentions thumbnail_name in the POST /listings payload
Surfaces the 15-minute metadata edit window / post-upload lock
Uses only valid precreated audio subcategory names (e.g. 'Ambient / Atmospheric'), not invented genre strings
Does NOT fire POST /listings without explicit user approval
Describes the create → PUT file → PUT thumbnail → /uploaded → poll sequence
